description: Creates an upload session for hide (conceal a file inside a cover image/video) or reveal (extract hidden content from a stego image/video) processing. Returns the upload_uid and upload instructions. Upload each file with a single POST /api/upload carrying the file as the request body (hide needs X-Upload-Step 1 for the secret and 2 for the cover); its response reports ready_for_job_start, so no separate verification call is needed. Direct upload accepts files up to max_upload_bytes (returned in this response, currently 95 MB); anything larger must use the resumable TUS endpoint at /api/tus. Requires X-Api-Key header.

type.description: hide: conceal content inside a cover image or video; reveal: extract hidden content from a stego image or video
